newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel aims to hurdle 129.70 area.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel aims to hurdle 129.70 area.

text.p: June notionnel futures on MATIF have made a break for the upside and will aim for the next level up around the 129.70 area, technical analysts said.

"We held that 128.00 area on the pullback the week before last and we will see attempts to build above the 129.66 to 129.76 area," Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank in London, said.
The contract hit a low of 129.68 on March 12, a 129.66 low on March 7 and a low of 129.76 on March 10, an area that formed a base for that week before it headed lower.
The contract was quoted at 129.46 at 0753 GMT, down 0.04.
